visualCharacteristics.structure: centered borderless grid, image above caption
visualCharacteristics.notes: No card chrome. Flex-wrap with justify-content:center so incomplete rows are centered. Default 3 per row desktop, four option 4 per row (flag grid, uppercase captions); 2 per row tablet; 1 (default) / 2 (four) per row mobile. Images keep their intrinsic size (icons ~80px, flags ~186px). Empty image cell -> text-only item (bold/heading line + grouped lines).
